title: A Look at Disrupted Software Stocks
assessment: The article accurately documents the Valaris catalyst and several relative-performance observations. Its strongest explanations distinguish capital intensity from accounting profits. claims.claim: Equal weighting historically benefits from size/value.
claims.reason: S&P’s research supports the smaller-size, value and anti-momentum tilts and historical equal-weight outperformance in its long samples. The live index began in January 2003; earlier decades are backtests. Entry endpoint, fees and turnover affect investor results, and subsequent mega-cap leadership can reverse long-window rankings. Historical attribution does not guarantee the next rotation.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Business quality and entry price differ.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
